seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Only the cursor (type player) changes; every other type is static scenery.
ACTION3/ACTION4 move the cursor to the previous/next editable glyph x, wrapping around (43<->15).
ACTION1/2 (glyph edits) have no visible effect because the schema has no pixels, so they are no-ops.
ACTION5/6/7 are no-ops. The move counter never changes in the data.
Not confirmed: cursor behaviour when glyphs sit on more than one row. The rule is stateless.
